name: lv_obj_scroll_by

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL object; relative scroll with optional animation

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155 image/IDB: Starts the scroll-x/scroll-y animations (lv_anim) or applies the offset at once; sends SCROLL_BEGIN/SCROLL_END. Located by its field layout in the LVGL v9.0 lv_obj_spec_attr_t and by the firmware's own Lua binding of the same method.

notes: Static recovery only; Mirage is emulator evidence. UI owner thread only. The object must be a live LVGL object created on this page.
